subject: Re: POC kickoff & timeline — Omega Corp trial planning
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@omegacorp.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC follow-up / success criteria & proposed timeline

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for a productive call today. Quick recap from our side and a proposed next step plan to get the POC moving: 

Summary & success criteria (from our discussion)
- Integrations: Redwood inference endpoint integrates with Omega's staging data pipeline (Kafka topic + S3 artifact fetch).
- Latency: 95th percentile generation latency under 650ms for 512-token prompts on dedicated instances.
- Throughput: Sustain 20 concurrent requests with acceptable tail latency (no more than 1% errors).
- Quality: Baseline accuracy on your 1,000-sample eval set (intent classification / reranking) with at least 88% match to your current model results.
- Security: Confirm network egress controls and SOC2 evidence for our hosted environment.

Proposed POC timeline (6 weeks) — draft
1) Kickoff (Week 0): technical onboarding, network allowlist, SSO/credentials, share evaluation dataset.
2) Week 1: Integration spike — connect ingestion and test inference on a small sample.
3) Week 2-3: Run evaluation, iterate prompts, capture perf/latency metrics.
4) Week 4: Scale testing (concurrency and longer prompts).
5) Week 5: Final readout & success criteria review.

Ownership
- Redwood: Marissa (AM) — program lead, Alex (SE) — integration & perf.
- Omega: Olivia — product lead, Raj — infra/network lead.

Next steps
- Please confirm the success criteria above (or suggest edits).
- Can we schedule a 60-min kickoff next week? Proposed slots: Tue 23 Jun 10:00-11:00 PT or Wed 24 Jun 13:00-14:00 PT.
- I'll share a one-pager SOW and a network requirements spreadsheet after we confirm kickoff.

I've attached a draft POC statement of work and the network checklist for your infra team.

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: POC_Statement_of_Work.pdf, network_requirements.xlsx

From: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@omegacorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@omegacorp.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC follow-up / success criteria & proposed timeline

Hi Marissa —

Appreciate the clear recap. This aligns closely with what we discussed — a couple small clarifications: 

- For quality: can we define the exact metric for the 88%? We'll share the evaluation spec (expected labels + scoring script).
- For latency: 650ms at 95th is our target for interactive workflows; for batch jobs our tolerance is higher. Can you confirm whether the 650ms target assumes dedicated instances?
- SOC2 evidence: our security team will need a SOC2 type 2 report and an SLA note about data retention.

Kickoff: Tue 23 Jun 10:00 PT works for Olivia and Raj. Please send calendar invite.

Also looping in our procurement person separately this week to review SOW terms.

Thanks —
Olivia
Senior Product Manager, Omega Corp
olivia.barnes@omegacorp.com

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@omegacorp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC follow-up / success criteria & proposed timeline

Hi Olivia —

Quick technical notes we should cover on the kickoff: 
- Dedicated instance confirmation: the 650ms 95th target is for Redwood Dedicated with standard 16GB GPU instances; if you need lower latency we'll discuss a higher-tier instance profile.
- Dataset handling: please share the eval set as a CSV with columns [input, expected_label]. We'll run your scoring script if you provide it; otherwise we can run our standard micro-F1 and thresholded exact-match metrics.
- Network: Raj, we'll need a list of IPs to allowlist and a service account with S3 read access for your eval artifacts.
- Monitoring: we'll enable per-route latency dashboards and token-level cost breakdown during the POC.

Proposed kickoff agenda (60 mins)
1) Introductions & roles (5 mins)
2) POC success criteria and acceptance gates (10 mins)
3) Network & auth checklist (10 mins)
4) Integration plan (20 mins)
5) Eval plan & metrics (10 mins)
6) Next steps & calendar items (5 mins)

I can own the integration spike and the perf runs; Jonas will help with dashboard setup and load tests.

See you Tue 23rd 10:00 PT — calendar invite incoming from Marissa.

Best,
Alex
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Great — invite sent for Tue 23 Jun 10:00-11:00 PT. Calendar includes kickoff agenda and links to the Drive folder for artifacts.

Action items before kickoff (owners)
- Olivia / Omega: share eval dataset and scoring script (owner: Olivia) — due Tue 23 Jun EOD PT.
- Raj / Omega infra: provide allowlist IPs and S3 service account (owner: Raj) — due Mon 22 Jun EOD PT.

We'll run weekly 30-min check-ins after kickoff on Wednesdays to review progress and blockers. Final readout planned for Fri 31 Jul 2026.

If anything changes please update the calendar. Looking forward to starting.

Thanks,
Marissa
